title: Let the Guru's word lift you into real stature
summary: The Guru's word lifts the soul into true stature. Let the Guru's word, not your image, define stature.
takeaway: Let the Guru's word, not your image, define stature.
lifeApplication: Before reaching for a higher image, return to the Guru's word until honor feels received rather than performed.
